findings.evidence: Lines 37-49 use `H` only at line 49 via `H.eq_fst t (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr (p.2 u hu))`; this can be replaced by membership in any `S` using `hx` and `p.2 u hu`. The downstream signatures at lines 59-70 repeat the same singleton restriction.
findings.fix: State the lemmas with `{S : Set X} (hx : x ∈ S) (H : f.HomotopicRel g S)` and derive the singleton versions, if desired, as corollaries.
findings.issue: `map_homotopic_of_homotopicRel`, `map_eq_of_homotopicRel`, and `mapHom_eq_of_homotopicRel` require `H : f.HomotopicRel g {x}`, but the argument only uses that `p u = x` puts the boundary point in the relative set.

summary: The new invariance lemmas are under-generalized: they require the homotopy to be relative exactly to the singleton basepoint, although the proof only needs the basepoint to lie in the relative set.
